categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the design, production, and sales of copper-clad laminates, prepregs, and printed circuit boards (PCBs). It produces high-end electronic materials including copper-clad laminates, semi-cured sheets, insulating laminates, metal-based copper-clad laminates, coated resin copper foil, and cover films. These products serve applications in high computing power, AI servers, 5G antennas, next-generation communication base stations, aerospace, chip packaging, automotive electronics, smart home, industrial control, medical devices, household appliances, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes high standards in quality, performance, and reliability with proprietary production of copper-clad laminates and related materials. It has developed advanced technologies for ultra-low loss halogen-free copper-clad laminates for next-generation servers, high thermal conductivity copper-clad laminates for 5G communication power supplies, high-reliability HDI laminates for high-end storage, and metal-based substrates with thermal conductivity ≥10 W/m·K. The company also focuses on R&D in multi-chip system packaging materials, low-warp packaging laminates for ETS processes, and high-speed low-CTE low-loss laminates for base station backplanes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in AI servers, 5G communication, telecommunications backbone networks, high-end servers, automotive electronics, smart home devices, industrial control, medical equipment, large displays, LED backlighting and lighting, chip packaging, and consumer electronics. The company serves global high-end electronic product markets and maintains strong relationships with leading manufacturers in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Guangdong (Dongguan), Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, and Suzhou. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and Thailand. Overseas sales account for a significant portion of revenue, with exports managed through Hong Kong and Thailand entities. The company is expanding its overseas footprint, especially in Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing key electronic materials such as copper-clad laminates and prepregs that are essential inputs for PCB manufacturers and downstream electronic product assemblers. It does not engage in upstream raw material mining or downstream final product assembly but focuses on supplying high-performance materials to PCB producers and electronic component manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core business of copper-clad laminates, expanding market share in high-end segments, and accelerating overseas market development. R&D focuses on next-generation server materials, 5G communication substrates, high-reliability HDI laminates, metal-based substrates for thermal management, multi-chip system packaging materials, and environmentally friendly, high-performance electronic materials. The company also invests in digital transformation, lean manufacturing, quality management, and ESG initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of copper-clad laminates, prepregs, and printed circuit boards. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by limited distribution channels. Revenue recognition follows delivery and transfer of control to customers, including VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) arrangements where revenue is recognized upon customer usage. The company also earns investment income from equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to Prismark data, the company ranks second globally in rigid copper-clad laminate sales with a 14% market share in 2023. It competes with major global suppliers in a concentrated market where the top three players hold about 39% market share. The company emphasizes its technological innovation, quality certifications, and comprehensive product portfolio to maintain a leading position in the high-end electronic materials market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 20.39 billion, a 22.92% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.74 billion, up 49.37%. Total assets reached RMB 27.64 billion, growing 10.77% from the previous year. The company maintains strong profitability with a net asset return rate of 12.17%. It has steadily increased production and sales volumes across its main product lines, demonstrating robust growth and scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-quality, high-performance, and reliable electronic materials tailored to meet the demanding requirements of advanced applications such as AI servers, 5G communications, and automotive electronics. It emphasizes technological innovation, proprietary R&D capabilities, comprehensive quality certifications, and strong customer service. The company also focuses on cost optimization, flexible pricing strategies, and supply chain collaboration to provide competitive and value-added solutions to its customers.
